Objective Comparison

How We Compare to Local Fabricators

A transparent look at the differences between certified engineering and low-cost shortcuts.

INVISPROTECT STANDARDS

Certified Architectural Excellence

  • Virgin SS316 Marine Alloy: Guaranteed 2.5% Molybdenum; lab test certificate provided on request.
  • IS 3521 Safety Harnesses: Technicians wear certified dual-lanyard fall arrest gear during entire job.
  • Hydraulic Swaging & Tensioning: Consistent 100+ kg tension per cable calibrated by gauge.
  • Official 10-Year Digital Warranty: Direct company warranty with free 3-month re-tension check.
  • Society RWA Compliance: Conforms strictly to elevation rules of luxury gated communities.
UNORGANIZED CONTRACTORS

Typical Shortcuts & Risks

  • Inferior SS202 / SS304 Steel: Rusts and stains within 6–12 months, requiring complete replacement.
  • Zero Safety Gear: Workers stand dangerously barefoot on 20th floor edges without lifelines.
  • Manual Hand Pulling: Uneven loose cables that sag, flutter in the wind, and allow children to pull them apart.
  • Verbal False Guarantees: No registered business identity; contractor stops answering calls after payment.
  • Society Disapproval: Ugly misaligned tracks that result in warning notices from apartment RWAs.
Metallurgical Certification

Safety Is Not A Marketing Slogan

Every InvisProtect installation is backed by physical laboratory metallurgical certification, calibrated mechanical tensioning, and strict work-at-height engineering standards.

SS316 MARINE ALLOY

Virgin SS316 Marine Grade

Enriched with 2.5% Molybdenum to prevent pitting corrosion. Will never rust or stain, even in coastal salt air or heavy monsoon climates.

400+ KGF TESTED

400+ kg Breaking Load

High-tensile cables withstand massive instantaneous impact. Impossible for toddlers or energetic pets to separate or force through.

IS 3521 HARNESS

Certified Technicians

Our field teams undergo rigorous work-at-height certification. Every high-rise tower installation utilizes dual-lanyard lifelines and helmet gear.

10 YEARS DIRECT

Maintenance Effort ✓ Zero maintenance; simple water wipe down ✗ High; rust scraping, sanding & messy paint
